results.overview: When Pete and Ellie decide to start a family, they stumble into the world of foster care adoption. They hope to take in one small child but when they meet three siblings, including a rebellious 15 year old girl, they find themselves speeding from zero to three kids overnight.

results.title: Grave Encounters
results.overview: A crew from a paranormal reality television show lock themselves in a haunted psychiatric hospital. They search for evidence of paranormal activity as they shoot what ends up becoming their final episode.

results.title: Sidelined 2: Intercepted
results.overview: Freshman star quarterback Drayton struggles with the weight of expectations after a devastating setback, while dancer Dallas begins to question the future she thought she wanted. As their high school relationship begins to unravel under the pressures of distance and self-discovery, they’ll learn that the bravest versions of themselves emerge when they let life redirect them.

results.title: Mechanic: Resurrection
results.overview: Arthur Bishop thought he had put his murderous past behind him when his most formidable foe kidnaps the love of his life. Now he is forced to travel the globe to complete three impossible assassinations, and do what he does best, make them look like accidents.

results.title: Hostel
results.overview: A hostel is a student's second home, but what happens when this safe place turns into a torture house? A gripping thriller, depicting the effects of ragging.

results.title: The Shape of Water
results.overview: An other-worldly story, set against the backdrop of Cold War era America circa 1962, where a mute janitor working at a lab falls in love with an amphibious man being held captive there and devises a plan to help him escape.

results.title: The Expendables 2
results.overview: Mr. Church reunites the Expendables for what should be an easy paycheck, but when one of their men is murdered on the job, their quest for revenge puts them deep in enemy territory and up against an unexpected threat.

results.title: 10 Cloverfield Lane
results.overview: After a catastrophic car crash, a young woman wakes up in a survivalist's underground bunker, where he claims to have saved her from an apocalyptic attack that has left the outside world uninhabitable.

results.title: The Melomaniac
results.overview: The leader of a marching band demonstrates an unusual way of writing music.

results.title: Stardom Triangle Derby I in Joetsu
results.overview: Stardom Triangle Derby I in Joetsu was a professional wrestling event promoted by World Wonder Ring Stardom, held on February 11, 2023, at Duo CEREZO in Joetsu, Niigata, Japan. It was the tenth event for the first-ever Triangle Derby, a round-robin six-woman tag team tournament created by the company.

results.title: The Ice Age Adventures of Buck Wild
results.original_title: The Ice Age Adventures of Buck Wild
results.overview: The fearless one-eyed weasel Buck teams up with mischievous possum brothers Crash & Eddie as they head off on a new adventure into Buck's home: The Dinosaur World.

results.title: Jackrabbit Biker
results.overview: They took his lucky foot. Now he'll take their lives. Jackrabbit Biker. This summer.

results.title: Lethal Weapon
results.overview: A veteran cop and an unstable detective become partners who must put their differences aside in order to bring down a heroin-smuggling ring run by ex-Special Forces.

results.title: Dacoit
results.overview: Betrayed by his better half, a man is convicted for a crime he didn't commit. Once free, he hunts her down in pursuit of vengeance, as their stories intertwine with a series of robberies.

results.title: NN4444
results.overview: Four unsettling short films exploring psychological horror: a man who barks like a dog at strangers, madness at a party, eerie phenomena following a friend's death, and a lakeside gathering cursed by water.

results.title: Fargo
results.overview: Jerry, a small-town Minnesota car salesman is bursting at the seams with debt... but he's got a plan. He's going to hire two thugs to kidnap his wife in a scheme to collect a hefty ransom from his wealthy father-in-law. It's going to be a snap and nobody's going to get hurt... until people start dying. Enter Police Chief Marge, a coffee-drinking, parka-wearing - and extremely pregnant - investigator who'll stop at nothing to get her man. And if you think her small-time investigative skills will give the crooks a run for their ransom... you betcha!

results.title: Creation of the Gods I: Kingdom of Storms
results.overview: Based on the most well-known classical fantasy novel of China, Fengshenyanyi, the trilogy is a magnificent eastern high fantasy epic that recreates the prolonged mythical wars between humans, immortals and monsters, which happened more than three thousand years ago.

results.title: Just Like a Cat
results.overview: A couple is looking for distractions: Julia creates relationships with her daughter’s boyfriend Nancy and with her bodyguard Frank, James seeks contact with her friend Baby Ryan, and so on, between maids, secretaries, girls and men of the house.

results.title: Silent Friend
results.overview: In the heart of a botanical garden in a medieval university town in Germany stands a majestic ginkgo tree. This silent witness has observed over a century the quiet rhythms of transformation across three human lives. At three distinct moments across the 20th and 21st centuries, these people — each carrying their own questions and inner struggles — inevitably find themselves drawn into the presence of this tree, full of mystery and meaning.

results.title: Furious Attack
results.overview: A former special forces soldier infiltrates northern Myanmar to rescue his missing daughter, fighting against scam gangs and organ traffickers in a final showdown with the crime boss.

results.title: Robot
results.overview: From its creation to its destruction, we follow a humanoid robot whose task is to take care of a Hungarian high-school. Every day is a new kind of torture in this weird, anti-comedic experimental short film.

results.title: Goldfinger
results.overview: Special agent 007 comes face to face with one of the most notorious villains of all time, and now he must outwit and outgun the powerful tycoon to prevent him from cashing in on a devious scheme to raid Fort Knox -- and obliterate the world's economy.

results.title: Adoration
results.overview: Lil and Roz are two lifelong friends, having grown up together as neighbors in an idyllic beach town. As adults, their sons have developed a friendship as strong as that which binds their mothers. One summer, all four are confronted by simmering emotions that have been mounting between them, and each find unexpected happiness in relationships that cross the bounds of convention.

results.title: It Boy
results.overview: 38-year-old Alice has everything to become the next editor-in-chief of Rebelle magazine except for her uptight image. But when the young and charming Balthazar, barely 20, crosses Alice's path, she realizes that he holds the key to her promotion.

results.title: Dr. No
results.overview: Agent 007 battles mysterious Dr. No, a scientific genius bent on destroying the U.S. space program. As the countdown to disaster begins, Bond must go to Jamaica, where he encounters beautiful Honey Ryder, to confront a megalomaniacal villain in his massive island headquarters.

results.title: Africa Blood and Guts
results.overview: A chronicle of the violence that occurred in much of the African continent throughout the 1960s. As many African countries were transitioning from colonial rule to other forms of government, violent political upheavals were frequent. Revolutions in Zanzibar and Kenya in which thousands were killed are shown, the violence not only political; there is also extensive footage of hunters and poachers slaughtering different types of wild animals.

results.title: What Women Want
results.overview: Advertising executive Nick Marshall is as cocky as they come, but what happens to a chauvinistic guy when he can suddenly hear what women are thinking? Nick gets passed over for a promotion, but after an accident enables him to hear women's thoughts, he puts his newfound talent to work against Darcy, his new boss, who seems to be infatuated with him.

results.title: ¡Mátame, cornudo!
results.overview: A friendship falls apart when a bandit discovers that his wife has been unfaithful to him with his best friend. As a result, the bandit kidnaps him and prepares to kill him. However, his friend will try to throw him off the scent in order to escape the situation unscathed.

results.title: Fort Valor
results.overview: The story follows 10-year-old Conner, who is struggling with his father's long deployment and is withdrawn, spending all his time playing a world-building video game. His Uncle Sean takes him on a drive in an attempt to reconnect, using the game as a bridge. Together, they embark on a mission in the game, rescuing a hostage in a high-stakes, action-packed adventure. The playful yet tense game mirrors Conner's feelings about his father's absence, and through teamwork, Conner learns about sacrifice, bravery, and trust. The story blends real-world emotions with action-packed virtual experiences, leading to a heartfelt connection between uncle and nephew.

results.title: Reverse
results.overview: Barney lives alone with his father, in a tiny house in the suburbs. He tries to live a normal life,  If Barney is different. His gravity is inverted.

results.title: Infinite
results.overview: Evan McCauley has skills he never learned and memories of places he has never visited. Self-medicated and on the brink of a mental breakdown, a secret group that call themselves “Infinites” come to his rescue, revealing that his memories are real.

results.title: La Violinista
results.overview: A young violinist must discover whether her music belongs to the world, her family, or herself.

results.title: Crise: Robofoot
results.overview: First single from the album "por favor, me perdoe. as más notícias finalmente chegaram" by Crise, which will be released soon.

results.title: Moral Debt
results.overview: After a rough but successful heist, two disgruntled criminals share waters and discuss their morality

results.title: Faster
results.overview: After 10 years in prison, Driver is now a free man with a single focus - hunting down the people responsible for brutally murdering his brother.

results.title: Bad Boys for Life
results.overview: Marcus and Mike are forced to confront new threats, career changes, and midlife crises as they join the newly created elite team AMMO of the Miami police department to take down the ruthless Armando Armas, the vicious leader of a Miami drug cartel.

results.title: Fifty Shades Darker
results.overview: When a wounded Christian Grey tries to entice a cautious Ana Steele back into his life, she demands a new arrangement before she will give him another chance. As the two begin to build trust and find stability, shadowy figures from Christian’s past start to circle the couple, determined to destroy their hopes for a future together.

results.title: The Princess Diaries 2: Royal Engagement
results.overview: Mia Thermopolis is now a college graduate and on her way to Genovia to take up her duties as princess. Accompanied by her friend Lilly, Mia continues her 'princess lessons', like riding horses side-saddle and archery. But her already complicated life is turned upside down once again when she learns that she is to take the crown as queen earlier than expected, all while she meets a mysteriously charming young man.

results.title: The Accountant
results.overview: As a math savant uncooks the books for a new client, the Treasury Department closes in on his activities and the body count starts to rise.

results.title: Black Clover: Sword of the Wizard King
results.original_title: 映画 ブラッククローバー 魔法帝の剣
results.overview: As a lionhearted boy who can't wield magic strives for the title of Wizard King, four banished Wizard Kings of yore return to crush the Clover Kingdom.

results.title: Eudaimonia
results.overview: When Isaac, a young teen struggling with his self-worth, finds a new identity as popular singer-songwriter Ace Duncan, in an unconscious attempt to save himself from his depression.

results.title: Red Notice
results.overview: An Interpol-issued Red Notice is a global alert to hunt and capture the world's most wanted. But when a daring heist brings together the FBI's top profiler and two rival criminals, there's no telling what will happen.

results.title: Info Loker
results.overview: Hardi is a jobless broke guy who is looking for a job, until one day he "accidentally" meets his old friend who now works as an illegal parking attendant. That meeting brings him to the job he was looking for, but the job is informal and has an unfavorable system.

results.title: Point Break
results.overview: In Los Angeles, a gang of bank robbers who call themselves The Ex-Presidents commit their crimes while wearing masks of Reagan, Carter, Nixon and Johnson. Believing that the members of the gang could be surfers, the F.B.I. sends young agent Johnny Utah to the beach undercover to mix with the surfers and gather information.

results.title: My Fair Lady
results.overview: A snobbish phonetics professor agrees to a wager that he can take a flower girl and make her presentable in high society.

results.title: Genesee
results.overview: We focus on two intertwined stories on the Rochester campus as a thriller and a romance unfold over the course of a week.

results.title: Vanilla Sky
results.overview: David Aames has it all: wealth, good looks and gorgeous women on his arm. But just as he begins falling for the warmhearted Sofia, his face is horribly disfigured in a car accident. That's just the beginning of his troubles as the lines between illusion and reality, between life and death, are blurred.

results.title: Ring
results.overview: A mysterious video has been linked to a number of deaths, and when an inquisitive journalist finds the tape and views it herself, she sets in motion a chain of events that puts her own life in danger.

results.title: The Northman
results.overview: Prince Amleth is on the verge of becoming a man when his father is brutally murdered by his uncle, who kidnaps the boy's mother. Two decades later, Amleth is now a Viking who's on a mission to save his mother, kill his uncle and avenge his father.

results.title: The Cat in the Hat
results.overview: During a rainy day, and while their mother is out, Conrad and Sally, and their pet fish, are visited by the mischievous Cat in the Hat. Fun soon turns to mayhem, and the siblings must figure out how to rid themselves of the maniacal Cat.

results.title: Dredd
results.overview: In the future, America is a dystopian wasteland. The latest scourge is Ma-Ma, a prostitute-turned-drug pusher with a dangerous new drug and aims to take over the city. The only possibility of stopping her is an elite group of urban police called Judges, who combine the duties of judge, jury and executioner to deliver a brutal brand of swift justice. But even the top-ranking Judge, Dredd, discovers that taking down Ma-Ma isn’t as easy as it seems in this explosive adaptation of the hugely popular comic series.

results.title: Poltergeist
results.overview: The Freelings' suburban home becomes the center of paranormal activity that opens a portal to the 'other side'. With help, they must cross over to get their daughter back.

results.title: Après le lancement : sortie des invités et du public
results.original_title: Après le lancement : sortie des invités et du public
results.overview: View of the audience, following the launch of a ship.

results.title: Old
results.overview: A group of families on a tropical holiday discover that the secluded beach where they are staying is somehow causing them to age rapidly – reducing their entire lives into a single day.

results.title: Pose
results.overview: Isolated in a grand country manor, a reclusive artist spends a passionate and paranoid weekend with his ex-lover, an obsessive fan, and a potential muse. Hoping to spark a new wave of artistic brilliance over the course of a few tumultuous days, filled with chaos and revelation not all of them will make it out alive.

results.title: Jack Reacher: Never Go Back
results.overview: Years after resigning command of an elite military police unit, the nomadic, righter-of-wrongs Reacher is drawn back into the life he left behind when his friend and successor, Major Susan Turner is framed for espionage. Reacher will stop at nothing to prove her innocence and to expose the real perpetrators behind the killings of his former soldiers.

results.title: Final Destination 2
results.overview: When Kimberly has a violent premonition of a highway pileup she blocks the freeway, keeping a few others meant to die, safe...Or are they? The survivors mysteriously start dying and it's up to Kimberly to stop it before she's next.

results.title: Weathering with You
results.overview: The summer of his high school freshman year, Hodaka runs away from his remote island home to Tokyo, and quickly finds himself pushed to his financial and personal limits. The weather is unusually gloomy and rainy every day, as if taking its cue from his life. After many days of solitude, he finally finds work as a freelance writer for a mysterious occult magazine. Then, one day, Hodaka meets Hina on a busy street corner. This bright and strong-willed girl possesses a strange and wonderful ability: the power to stop the rain and clear the sky.

results.title: Happy Gilmore 2
results.overview: Happy Gilmore isn't done with golf — not by a long shot. Since his retirement after his first Tour Championship win, Gilmore returns to finance his daughter's ballet classes.

results.title: The Piano Teacher
results.overview: Erika Kohut, a sexually repressed piano teacher living with her domineering mother, meets a young man who starts romantically pursuing her.

results.title: Good Time
results.overview: An old friend comes back after a long time. They spend good time together like nothing ever changed, watching TV, playing games, drinking beer, listening to music, and talking about life. For a moment, it feels like the good old days again. But when the friend leaves something feels different.

results.title: The Blair Witch Project
results.overview: In October of 1994 three student filmmakers disappeared in the woods near Burkittsville, Maryland, while shooting a documentary. A year later their footage was found.

results.title: Night at the Museum: Secret of the Tomb
results.original_title: Night at the Museum: Secret of the Tomb
results.overview: When the magic powers of The Tablet of Ahkmenrah begin to die out, Larry Daley spans the globe, uniting favorite and new characters while embarking on an epic quest to save the magic before it is gone forever.

results.title: Solo: A Star Wars Story
results.overview: Through a series of daring escapades deep within a dark and dangerous criminal underworld, Han Solo meets his mighty future copilot Chewbacca and encounters the notorious gambler Lando Calrissian.

results.title: Underworld: Rise of the Lycans
results.overview: A prequel to the first two Underworld films, this fantasy explains the origins of the feud between the Vampires and the Lycans. Aided by his secret love, Sonja, courageous Lucian leads the Lycans in battle against brutal Vampire king Viktor. Determined to break the king's enslavement of his people, Lucian faces off against the Death Dealer army in a bid for Lycan independence.

results.title: The King's Man
results.overview: As a collection of history's worst tyrants and criminal masterminds gather to plot a war to wipe out millions, one man must race against time to stop them.

results.title: Gravity
results.overview: Dr Ryan Stone, an engineer on her first space mission, and Matt Kowalski, an astronaut on his final expedition, have to survive in space after they are hit by debris while spacewalking.

results.title: Fist of Fury
results.overview: During the Japanese occupation of Shanghai, Chen Zhen, the star pupil of a recently-deceased martial arts teacher battles a Japanese dojo which seeks the demise of his fighting school.

results.title: Do Not Enter
results.overview: A group of young explorers investigates an old abandoned hotel, only to encounter a strange supernatural being and a competing group looking for a legendary hidden treasure.

results.title: Monster House
results.overview: Monsters under the bed are scary enough, but what happens when an entire house is out to get you? Three teens aim to find out when they go up against a decrepit neighboring home and unlock its frightening secrets.

results.title: The Lighthouse
results.overview: Two lighthouse keepers try to maintain their sanity while living on a remote and mysterious New England island in the 1890s.

results.title: The Expendables 3
results.overview: Barney, Christmas and the rest of the team comes face-to-face with Conrad Stonebanks, who years ago co-founded The Expendables with Barney. Stonebanks subsequently became a ruthless arms trader and someone who Barney was forced to kill… or so he thought. Stonebanks, who eluded death once before, now is making it his mission to end The Expendables -- but Barney has other plans. Barney decides that he has to fight old blood with new blood, and brings in a new era of Expendables team members, recruiting individuals who are younger, faster and more tech-savvy. The latest mission becomes a clash of classic old-school style versus high-tech expertise in the Expendables’ most personal battle yet.

results.title: I Don't Like Younger Men 2
results.overview: A film depicting the love between a divorced man and his daughter's friend.

results.title: Ghost
results.overview: After a young man is murdered, his spirit stays behind to warn his lover of impending danger, with the help of a reluctant psychic.

results.title: Wrong Turn 4: Bloody Beginnings
results.overview: A group of friends take refuge in a deserted sanatorium after they are left stranded in a snowstorm. Later, the place becomes a death trap when man-eating cannibals surround them.

results.title: Devour
results.overview: During a romantic evening arranged by her boyfriend, a young woman remains fixated on his relationship with a co-worker… Starring Haley Karlich and Jon Reisch.

results.title: Passing
results.overview: Zach, a transgender man, re-enters the dating scene, knowing he might face many people who have problems with his identity.

results.title: The Kissing Booth
results.overview: When teenager Elle's first kiss leads to a forbidden romance with the hottest boy in high school, she risks her relationship with her best friend.

results.title: Turbo
results.overview: The tale of an ordinary garden snail who dreams of winning the Indy 500.

results.title: Off the Grid
results.overview: After a morally-bankrupt company tries to weaponize a brilliant scientist's revolutionary technology, he goes off the grid to safeguard humanity. When the company sends a strike force to find him, they make their biggest mistake of all – they weaponize the man they are trying to catch.

results.title: The Aristocats
results.overview: When Madame Adelaide Bonfamille leaves her fortune to Duchess and her children—Bonfamille’s beloved family of cats—the butler plots to steal the money and kidnaps the legatees, leaving them out on a country road. All seems lost until the wily Thomas O’Malley Cat and his jazz-playing alley cats come to the aristocats’ rescue.

results.title: Jupiter Ascending
results.overview: In a universe where human genetic material is the most precious commodity, an impoverished young Earth woman becomes the key to strategic maneuvers and internal strife within a powerful dynasty…

results.title: Two Minutes
results.overview: Two brothers rob a corner shop only to be interrupted by their Nan.

results.title: Heroine in Peril Omnibus 24: Fighter of the Sun Leona MAMA
results.original_title: ヒロインピンチオムニバス24 太陽の戦士レオーナ MAMA
results.overview: The 24th entry in the Heroine in Peril Omnibus tokusatsu series, as well as an entry in the Fighter of the Sun Leona tokusatsu series.

results.title: RRR
results.overview: A fictional history of two legendary revolutionaries' journey away from home before they began fighting for their country in the 1920s.

results.title: Hairscare
results.overview: HairScare follows a string of grisly murders tied to a smiling, tight-knit family, with clues blurring the line between Nikki Blonsky and her larger-than-life persona, Tracy Turnblad—no one can tell which one is real anymore. In the final scene, a figure turns toward the camera, hair perfectly set and hands stained red…You cant stop the beat, but it can stop you...

results.title: Apocalypse Z: The Beginning of the End
results.original_title: Apocalipsis Z: el principio del fin
results.overview: When a kind of rabies that transforms people into aggressive creatures spreads across the planet, Manel isolates himself at home with his cat, relying on his wits to survive; but soon they must go out in search of food, by land and by sea, dodging many dangers.

results.title: The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo
results.original_title: The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo
results.overview: Disgraced journalist Mikael Blomkvist investigates the disappearance of a weary patriarch's niece from 40 years ago. He is aided by the pierced, tattooed, punk computer hacker named Lisbeth Salander. As they work together in the investigation, Blomkvist and Salander uncover immense corruption beyond anything they have ever imagined.

results.title: The Amorous Sisters
results.original_title: Julchen und Jettchen, die verliebten Apothekerstöchter
results.overview: Comedy about some schoolgirls being taught anatomy (of the sexual nature) by the sexually frustrated Barbara Moose. In bed at nighttime the girls practice their daily lessons on each other and on any unsuspecting visitors of the night. When they're not in class they enjoy frolicking around outside (naked most of the time!) experiencing the joys of nature.

results.title: The School of Rock
results.overview: Fired from his band and hard up for cash, guitarist and vocalist Dewey Finn finagles his way into a job as a fifth-grade substitute teacher at a private school, where he secretly begins teaching his straight-A students the finer points of rock 'n' roll and the power of sticking it to the man. But as the school’s stern principal closes in and the Battle of the Bands looms, Dewey must risk everything to prove that rock 'n' roll can change lives.

results.title: Fosh: The Movie
results.overview: A inflammatory story of two isolated and disillusioned Iranians in America. Two men who find no way to enter human society.

results.title: Layover
results.overview: A stranded Marine awaiting a flight home forges an unexpected bond with a marginalized stranger during one tense night in 1966.

results.title: Stardust
results.overview: In a countryside town bordering on a magical land, a young man makes a promise to his beloved that he'll retrieve a fallen star by venturing into the magical realm. His journey takes him into a world beyond his wildest dreams and reveals his true identity.

results.title: Hop
results.overview: E.B., the Easter Bunny's teenage son, heads to Hollywood, determined to become a drummer in a rock 'n' roll band. In L.A., he's taken in by Fred after the out-of-work slacker hits E.B. with his car.

results.title: Big Picnic
results.overview: The fun-loving Drahomanovs and the straight-laced Nalyvaichenkos battle for the same picnic spot — and deal with an additional unwanted guest.

results.title: SICK TRUTH
results.overview: Corey’s miserable life has been turned upside down when a deadly virus spreads across the globe. Most don’t even know they’re carrying it until it’s far too late. With a new national lockdown, Corey is stuck with his two housemates. But as he spends more and more time with them, reality and fantasy have begun to melt together and he’s no longer sure of anything, even himself.

results.title: The Traveling Companion
results.overview: A  ruined noble decides to organize a robbery on a luxury train. He decides to get help from a busty starlet that should distract passengers ...

results.title: Anniversary
results.overview: When Ellen and Paul’s son Josh introduces his new girlfriend at their 25th anniversary party, no one suspects that it is the beginning of the end for this happy family. The new girlfriend is Liz, Ellen’s former student, who left the university, some years before, after Ellen called her out in class for her radical ideology.

results.title: The Pope's Exorcist
results.overview: Father Gabriele Amorth, Chief Exorcist of the Vatican, investigates a young boy's terrifying possession and ends up uncovering a centuries-old conspiracy the Vatican has desperately tried to keep hidden.

results.title: Midwinter Hue
results.overview: A man steadily bashes through the snow. He disappears and the trees, covered in white, shift and show a beautiful array of hidden colors. A poetic, meditative short film about letting go of the past and embracing the unknown future.

results.title: Spaceballs
results.overview: When the nefarious Dark Helmet hatches a plan to snatch Princess Vespa and steal her planet's air, space-bum-for-hire Lone Starr and his clueless sidekick fly to the rescue. Along the way, they meet Yogurt, who puts Lone Starr wise to the power of "The Schwartz." Can he master it in time to save the day?

results.title: Monster
results.overview: After an outburst at school involving her son, a concerned single mother demands answers, triggering a sequence of deepening suspicion and turmoil.

results.title: La Perte
results.overview: In the silence of a cold morning, Ana repeats a meticulous and almost sacred culinary ritual to lure Chloe, her deceased grandmother's cat, who has been missing for a week. When her boyfriend, Julián, confronts her at the doorstep, urging her to accept reality, Ana breaks down, releasing the true pain she has been hiding. "La Perte" is an intimate portrait of denial, the weight of grief in everyday spaces, and how, sometimes, a shared ritual is what someone needs to finally let go of those who left us behind.

results.title: GGS - Ganteng-Ganteng Sange
results.overview: Kelas Bintang is back with this pack of drama called GGS - Ganteng-Ganteng Sange.

results.title: Crossing
results.overview: A retelling of the Red Army crossing the Chishui River four times to outmaneuver 400,000 enemy troops.

results.title: Green Lantern
results.overview: For centuries, a small but powerful force of warriors called the Green Lantern Corps has sworn to keep intergalactic order. Each Green Lantern wears a ring that grants him superpowers. But when a new enemy called Parallax threatens to destroy the balance of power in the Universe, their fate and the fate of Earth lie in the hands of the first human ever recruited.

results.title: Trade-Off
results.overview: Two friends have an investment opportunity in which they go to great measures to reach their initial investment money.

results.title: Ice Skater
results.overview: A survival drama about an ice skater stranded on an ice floe at the Arctic Sea. When the ice floe starts to float towards south and melt, the ice skater must use all means necessary to survive.

results.title: Nimrods
results.overview: Three friends journey from Kansas City to Los Angeles, mistakenly believing that their band is opening for Green Day on New Year’s Eve.

results.title: After Hours
results.overview: Two brothers trapped in poverty gamble on day trading as ambition turns to addiction. When one final all-in bet collapses, their home becomes a pressure cooker where love, pride, and survival collide.

results.title: Young Hearts
results.overview: 14-year-old Elias increasingly feels like an outsider in his village. When he meets his new neighbour of the same age, Alexander, Elias is confronted with his burgeoning sexuality.

results.title: Father of Independence
results.overview: As the rage against British colonization in Sri Lanka continues, civilians are having a new hope about their new activists.

results.title: Face Off 7: One Wish
results.overview: When a 73-year-old widow is forced to depend on the care of her 5 busy adult children after an injury, she begins to question the meaning of family love.

results.title: Battle of Oslo
results.overview: April 9th, 1940, Norway is under siege. As German warships close in on Oslo, Colonel Birger Eriksen, commander of the undermanned Oscarsborg Fortress, makes a bold decision that changes the course of history.

results.title: The Fly
results.overview: When brilliant, eccentric scientist Seth Brundle makes a huge technological breakthrough in teleportation, he decides to test it on himself. Unbeknownst to him, a common housefly manages to get inside the device and the two become one.

results.title: Erotic Tutoring 2
results.overview: Bar examiner Yoo-jeong likes sex more than studying. Thanks to the secretive, but erotic tutoring by the teacher her boyfriend introduced to her, Yoo-jeong’s grades shoot up. Yoo-jeong’s mom, Mi-jin, however, feels attracted to her tutor and starts seducing him.

results.title: Fantastic Four: Rise of the Silver Surfer
results.original_title: Fantastic Four: Rise of the Silver Surfer
results.overview: The Fantastic Four return to the big screen as a new and all powerful enemy threatens the Earth. The seemingly unstoppable 'Silver Surfer', but all is not what it seems and there are old and new enemies that pose a greater threat than the intrepid superheroes realize.

results.title: Brothers
results.overview: When his helicopter goes down during his fourth tour of duty in Afghanistan, Marine Sam Cahill is presumed dead. Back home, brother Tommy steps in to look over Sam’s wife, Grace, and two children. Sam’s surprise homecoming triggers domestic mayhem.

results.title: Louis C.K.: Ridiculous
results.overview: From a bee getting shot in New York City to paying strangers to take his aging father, Louis C.K. unleashes the ridiculous thoughts in his mind.

results.title: Sexual Chronicles of a French Family

As our heroes are propelled into an epic chess game of life and death, love will be challenged, friendships will be torn apart, and sacrifices must be made for the only family Kirk has left: his crew.

Unaware of his Indian heritage and armed with a comically British accent, Happy’s blunders trigger a string of chaotic mishaps that could lead him to expose a criminal network.

results.title: Walkout

results.title: Jason Lives - Friday the 13th Part VI
results.original_title: Jason Lives - Friday the 13th Part VI
results.overview: Tommy Jarvis, tormented by the fear that maybe Jason isn't really dead, unwittingly resurrects the mass murderer for another bloody rampage.

His mission is to avenge his father and save a mission sabotaged by greedy weapons manufacturers. He also gets involved in a relationship with Ramada Thompson, a woman with an unusually talented stomach. The Ranger, donning a mask and riding a white stallion named Silver, teams up with Tonto to bring the unscrupulous gang and others of that ilk to justice.

Now in the modern time a dark past is coming back, an epic fight between HUMANS and REPTILIANS is about to start and the world is going to learn the truth. The reptilians now stronger than ever are looking for revenge, but there's good people on both sides who want to keep the peace on earth and our future depends on them.

Once aboard, Rowan loses consciousness and awakens in a pastel pink house within a dreamlike world where everything feels eerily perfect.

results.title: Inequality for All
results.overview: Based on Reich's 2010 book Aftershock: The Next Economy and America's Future, the film examines widening income inequality in the United States.  U.S. Labor Secretary Robert Reich tries to raise awareness of the country's widening economic gap. He publicly argued about the issue for decades, and producing a film of his viewpoints was a "final frontier" for him. In addition to being a social issue documentary, Inequality for All is also partially a biopic regarding Reich's early life and his time as Secretary of Labor under Bill Clinton's presidency. Warren Buffett and Nick Hanauer, two entrepreneurs and investors in the top 1%, are interviewed in the film, supporting Reich's belief in an economy that benefits all citizens, including those of the middle and lower classes.

results.title: Murder on the Orient Express

Todd Johnson struggles as an emerging actor as he deals with annoying callbacks, strange media requests, and shady agents.

On one of these massive traction cities, the old London, Tom Natsworthy has an unexpected encounter with a mysterious young woman from the wastelands who will change the course of his life forever.
